response.justification: Bogdan is a broadly experienced, versatile senior engineer with genuine geospatial/GIS domain exposure (GISCollective, Green Map, FOSS4G talk) and some high-performance, low-latency backend work in D at Sociomantic. However, the role's core requirement — modern C++ (or Rust) systems development for a routing data pipeline — is only weakly evidenced: his C/C++ work was a short 7-month stint at National Instruments over a decade ago, and his skills list omits C++ and Rust entirely. Recent experience is predominantly TypeScript/Node full-stack and AI tooling, not large-scale distributed data pipelines or navigation systems. He could be a fit for a team willing to invest in ramp-up given his demonstrated language-agnostic learning ability, but he is not a strong match against the stated technical bar.
strengths: Genuine geospatial/GIS platform experience (GISCollective, Green Map, FOSS4G talk)
Low-latency, high-throughput microservices work (millions of req/s at Sociomantic)
Strong engineering craft: TDD, CI/CD, testing tooling, Linux, Docker/Kubernetes
concerns: Modern C++/Rust experience essentially absent; C/C++ only briefly in 2014-2015
No navigation/routing tiling or map-data pipeline experience
Recent roles are TypeScript/Node full-stack, drifting from systems engineering
